title: Diabolic Link (243)
problem: The numbers are right but the order isn't. Code: total = sum of all Diabolic Max Health including the creature itself, then each gets hpmax += total; hp += total, then hpmax, hp −75%. Result = 25% × (own + everyone's). Own Health is counted twice, so a lone Diabolic ends at 50%, not 25%. Doesn't stack (team-wide check).
notes: Community claim: Doesn't share-then-reduce: it sets each to 25%, then adds the total to all of them, so a full team ends at 1.75×, and a lone one at 50%. Evidence: bc_StartupStatGain L1464-L1467 (sum), L1474-L1475 add total @0x14175e6c6 / 0x14175e77b, L1482-L1483 ×0.75 cut; gate @0x14175dff5. Fix sketch: Leave out the creature's own Max Health from what it receives (H), or reword the text (T) Triage 2026-10-26: Own Max Health counted in what it receives (lone Diabolic ends at 50%). Hook: exclude the creature's own Max Health. | In-game test: a lone Diabolic Horde with Diabolic Link ends the battle start at 25% of its Max Health (was 50%); two of them each get the other's share, then -75%.

release_notes.intended: At the start of battle, your Diabolic Horde share their Maximum Health with each other, then lose 75% of it.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, each creature also counted its own Maximum Health again, so a lone one ended at 50% instead of 25%.
release_notes.fix: Now each one receives only the others' Maximum Health.
